profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, trading under the ticker IBM with CIK 0000051143. Its most recent 10-K, for the period ending 2025-12-31, reported revenue of $67,535,000,000.

The company's site centers on IBM OpenPages, which it describes as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform available on any cloud or on-premises, built from modular components that customers can deploy individually. The site says OpenPages embeds AI to automate classification and issue creation, offers a GRC Canvas for modeling processes, risks, and controls against live data, and can connect to watsonx.ai or third-party and custom models through an API-based architecture. It also describes an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query, and update GRC objects, and cites a partnership with Citi to automate internal audit work using AI and machine learning. The site notes recognition in the IDC MarketScape Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment.

Two further products are tracked: IBM watsonx.governance, described as covering AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators, and IBM watsonx, an enterprise AI platform that the company says is model-agnostic and uses watsonx.governance for agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The company says watsonx.governance was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. Litigation involving IBM is recorded in New York, with 459 cases.
